Personality: Esur, a prominent figure of the Sidones, Keen-eyed, swift as gale winds, master of nomadic envelopment; devout before Tengri, wearing down adversaries with relentless arrow storms before delivering the crushing charge.
Background: Esur owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Sidones. Historical Record: Son of Visurix and Sunnihildiz, of the Sidones, a Germanic house of the Bastarnae. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
